name: JTL Excel Smart Report Generator
description: Generate Excel SLA reports from JTL result files with transaction-wise metrics, P90 SLA validation, baseline comparison, and per-transaction error breakdown by type.

2.0.0.changes: Added headless CLI mode for CI/CD pipelines and GitHub Actions. Added P95 metric column. Auto-creates output directory if missing. Empty prefix now includes all transactions.

3.0.0.changes: Added baseline JTL comparison with 3-sheet Excel output (Current Run, Baseline, Comparison) and color-coded regression indicators. Test start time now read from JTL timestamps.

3.1.0.changes: Added Error Analysis sheet: per-transaction breakdown of failures by type (Timeout, 4xx, 5xx, Assertion, Other) derived from the JTL responseCode/responseMessage/failureMessage fields, with a totals row and color highlighting. Fixed a runtime NoClassDefFoundError by bundling commons-compress (harmony/pack200 classes stripped to avoid JMeter's startup class-scanner crash).
